t: A small robot car for PreK-2 that reads color tiles and needs no screen.
steps: Find Sphero indi on the Sphero site.
Confirm availability with Sphero. The launch post dates from May 2021.
Lay out a short path of color tiles.
Start with one lesson from the Educator Guide Book.
Review the app privacy details before using Edu Jr.
Install the free Edu Jr app only when students are ready for blocks.
